verdict.rationale: Fathom documents registrable outbound webhooks that POST meeting data (optionally summary, transcript and action items) to a URL of your choice. They can be created in the UI or via create/delete API endpoints, carry signed headers verifiable with an SDK helper, and are included on all plans. missing for 10: event types beyond new meeting content, documented retry/delivery semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Webhooks will send your meeting data (optionally including the summary, transcript, and action items) to a URL of your choice.
Create a webhook to receive new meeting content.
You also have the option of creating and deleting webhooks with an API call.
Each webhook request sent from Fathom includes a signature in the request headers, which you can use to confirm the authenticity of the payload.
Yes. API access—keys and webhooks— are included on all plans.
